scripts.prebuild: npm run validate:i18n && npm run validate:completed-image-metadata
scripts.predeploy:firebase: npm run build && npm run check:static-seo-ga
scripts.test:i18n-layout:full: playwright test --config=playwright.i18n.config.ts --project=desktop-chrome && playwright test --config=playwright.i18n.config.ts --project=pixel-7 --project=iphone-14 --workers=2 && playwright test --config=playwright.i18n.config.ts --project=ipad-gen7
scripts.test:essential-suite: npm run test:links && npm run test:static-seo && npm run test:alignment:en && npm run test:alignment:en:mobile
scripts.test:full-suite: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:home && npm run test:links && npm run test:search-index && npm run test:static-seo && npm run test:i18n-layout:full && npm run test:alignment:locales:mobile:full
scripts.prod-deploy: cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_ANALYTICS=true NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_ERROR_TRACKING=true NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_FIREBASE_EMULATOR=false npm run predeploy:firebase && npm run test:full-suite && cross-env DEPLOY_VIA_PROD_DEPLOY=true firebase deploy --only hosting && npm run verify:ga-live && npm run postdeploy
scripts.prod-deploy-light: cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_ANALYTICS=true NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_ERROR_TRACKING=true NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_FIREBASE_EMULATOR=false npm run predeploy:firebase && npm run test:essential-suite && cross-env DEPLOY_VIA_PROD_DEPLOY=true firebase deploy --only hosting && npm run verify:ga-live && npm run postdeploy
scripts.validate:production: npm run validate:i18n && npm run validate:no-hardcoded-jsx && npm run validate:assets && npm run validate:locale-links
